strategyReview: The live book is still dominated by WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG: clean live family evidence is strong at 305/439 wins (avg +0.33%) and shadows 188/253 (avg +0.99%), but the no-stop design is now showing concentrated mark-to-market bleed in names such as COIN -9.85% and HOOD -5.05%. ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO remains the best small-sample live edge (4/4, +0.74), with the newer ≥3pt edge gate still shadow-validating. The main failures are contrarian/rich-premium fades on gold and oil, plus HYPE-confirmed BTC momentum, all of which fire into already-moving markets and treat risk premium as mispricing.

failureClusters.theme: Gold cap-edge/nobias short signals are bullish drift, not overpricing
failureClusters.evidence: H-532 and H-534 each failed 0/20. After rich gold tail NO cap-edge triggers, gold spot was mostly flat or rose 1.8–5.4%, so the sell-YES edge did not predict a >2% decline within 2 days.
failureClusters.recommendation: Kill the gold underlying-cap short family and mark the cap-edge assumption invalid. Do not flip to long on the same raw trigger without a separate trend-confirmation mechanism.

failureClusters.theme: Unconditional CBRS funding threshold captures oscillation, not tail stress
failureClusters.evidence: H-539's cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10 produced mixed outcomes (2.3→-13.4 loss, -13.4→-4.3 win) and the family is only 12/25 scorable wins.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require true weekend context and an extreme z-score/percentile event rather than a static -10 threshold; consider waiting for stabilization or only using tail events.

failureClusters.theme: HYPE/BTC cross-asset confirmation arrives too late
failureClusters.evidence: The cross-asset family is 7/23 scorable; BTC dropped -2.9% to -3.5% while HYPE remained above its 24h SMA, showing HYPE risk-on was coincident beta rather than a durable BTC signal.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not use HYPE risk-on as a default BTC confirmation. If used, require HYPE not already extended and require OI expansion rather than merely not collapsing.

failureClusters.theme: OIL one-touch NO edge shorts fight upside drift
failureClusters.evidence: find_0018 losses show OIL rising 2.8–10.0% after sell-YES edge triggers; the family is only 11/21 and the losers are much larger than the wins.
failureClusters.recommendation: Only sell short-dated OIL NO premium when spot is below the 24h SMA and the edge is strong enough to pay for theta/edge decay, not as an unconditional fade.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: Restrict CBRS long to true weekend days and require funding in an extreme negative 7d z-score tail (< -2), so the signal fires on genuine weekend funding stress rather than routine negative oscillation.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot will gain >2% within 2 days as extreme weekend funding normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-024: Do not fade gold P/C collapse/rich settlement EV as a standalone overbought signal. Take the short only when gold spot is already below its 24h SMA and settlement EV is rolling over, so the trade aligns with actual near-term deterioration rather than fighting a rally.
newHypotheses.prediction: Gold spot will decline >2% within 3 days when extreme put/call lows are confirmed by falling spot and settlement EV.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-108: Preserve the BTC trend confirmation idea but require HYPE to be below the top of its 7d range and expanding OI, so HYPE is a fresh risk-on signal rather than late-stage FOMO confirmation.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot will gain >2% within 3 days when HYPE confirms risk-on from a non-overextended condition.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-551: Require short-dated OIL one-touch contracts, a stronger sell-YES edge, and OIL spot below the 24h SMA, so the NO premium fade is powered by expiry decay and not fighting persistent upside drift.
newHypotheses.prediction: OIL NO position gains as short-dated rich YES premium decays when spot is not trending higher.

newHypotheses.description: BTC one-touch NO premium fade: sell YES on above-strike BTC contracts when sell-YES edge is 3-8 points, spread is tight, liquidity is large, and nearest expiry is within 14 days.
newHypotheses.prediction: The YES price will decline / NO position profits within 3 days as the edge corrects.

newHypotheses.description: Smart-money dip-YES asymmetry: on BTC downside one-touch contracts only, when smart flow is net long YES and the YES ask is still cheap, go long spot/perp because smart money is positioning against overpriced downside.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot will rally >2% within 3 days when smart wallets are net long YES on downside one-touch contracts.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The single cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10 threshold fires in both directions; examples include 2.3 → -13.4 (loss) and -13.4 → -4.3 (win). It captures ordinary negative funding oscillation, not extreme positioning.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The family's short variants lost as gold spot rose 1.8–5.1% after the P/C collapse and PM settlement EV >4800 trigger. Rich settlement EV was not a fadeable overbought anchor; gold continued to drift higher.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme low gold GLD put/call with PM settlement EV above 4800 is a fadeable overbought condition rather than a mark of continued upside drift.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC lost -2.9% to -3.5% while HYPE was above its 24h SMA; HYPE risk-on participation did not confirm durable BTC momentum.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE risk-on participation confirms durable BTC momentum rather than marking late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The >2pt sell-YES edge on OIL above-strike contracts repeatedly lost in rising tape; OIL spot rose 2.8–10.0%, pushing YES prices up rather than decaying.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Sell-YES edge >2pt on OIL above-strike one-touch contracts is a pure pricing error rather than compensation for upside drift.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-532 failed every scorable test. Gold spot was flat or rose after the rich tail NO gap, so the no-bias adjusted gap did not predict bearish continuation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-534 failed every scorable test. Gold spot rose up to 5.4% after the one-touch cap-edge trigger, showing the edge reflected structural premium rather than directional bearish flow.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's main lesson is that several shadow-mined contrarian signals were actually trend-compensation: gold cap-edge/nobias shorts, gold P/C collapse shorts, and OIL sell-YES fades all lost in rising tape. I persisted invalidation marks on the failing gold cap-edge families and refined CBRS, gold P/C, HYPE/BTC, and OIL variants with regime-relative conditions. I also added a stop to WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG because the current no-stop design allowed COIN/HOOD-sized mark-to-market bleed; that change should be watched to confirm it improves realized payoff without degrading the edge.
